title: Align test-run HTTP route documentation with bounded pagination
outcome: Update the per-route feature contract and architecture endpoint row to match the bounded test-run listing already implemented.
acceptance: The Slice 1 HTTP bullet in docs/features/test-runs.md and the GET /api/test-runs endpoint row in docs/architecture.md describe the default 100/max 200 cap, limit/after parameters, limit/nextCursor response and applicable 400 cases, or link directly to the authoritative pagination contract without claiming all indexed runs are returned in one response.
Existing exact-ID detail/log behavior and live snapshot/delta documentation remain accurate; the documentation change is independently reviewed under the project landing process.
